|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Arcane Cloak''' is a [[guard skill]] that consumes a large amount of [[mana]] to apply a buff that absorbs incoming damage for a short period of time. The buff absorbs more damage and grants added [[lightning damage]] the more mana was spent. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''Guard skill:''' [[Guard skill]]s share a [[cooldown]] with other guard skills. The cooldown does not recover during their effect. '''Mana spent:''' Arcane Cloak spends mana, which allows it to interact with effects based on mana spent, such as {{il|Arcane Surge Support}} and {{il|Indigon}}. '''Mana cost:''' Arcane Cloak technically has a mana [[cost]] of 0. Its skill effect is not a [[cost]], and accordingly, it is unaffected by cost modifiers, cannot be paid with Energy Shield through {{psl|Eldritch Battery}}, and cannot be changed to spend another resource through e.g. {{il|Lifetap Support}} or {{il|Whispers of Infinity}}. '''Buff effect:''' Buff effect scales the stats granted to the user, by default only the added lightning damage. It does not affect the amount of mana spent or the amount of damage the buff can take. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Mana
